After wrapping gifts, I did dishes and put dinner in the oven, and asked him to turn it off to spend time with me with/without kids. He said no. That the stream was only for today and it is not okay for me to expect him to stop doing what he finds enjoyable just because I want him to do something I find enjoyable. But if I was okay letting him spend $100 on app purchases for this game (same one he's watching) that he'd shut it off no problem. But last year he spent a little over $2,000 on in-app purchases for this game, and after a lengthy discussion, said he wouldn't buy anymore. So I'm not a huge fan of okaying any more money for it. It's almost 6pm and says he doesn't know when it will end, but that there are 2 more streamers left. I feel like the evening is almost over and I am so disappointed and feel saddened that he would rather watch games than spend time with me. Am I an asshole for being upset and having unrealistic expectations?

Answer: <0 or 1>

prediction.raw:
I would answer: 0 (NTA - Not The Asshole)

Reasoning: 

The husband's behavior and response seem unreasonable and dismissive of the wife's feelings and needs. He prioritized watching video game streams over spending time with his family, despite his wife's requests. His justification that the stream is only for today and that he shouldn't have to stop doing something he enjoys because his wife wants to do something else is not a valid reason to ignore his family's needs.

Additionally, his attempt to bargain with his wife, offering to shut off the stream if she allows him to spend $100 on in-app purchases, is not only unfair but also goes against their previous agreement. This behavior suggests that he is not considering his wife's feelings or the impact of his actions on their relationship.

The wife's expectations of spending time with her husband and family in the evening are reasonable, especially after she has taken care of household chores and prepared dinner. Her feelings of disappointment and sadness are understandable, given her husband's prioritization of his hobby over their family time.

Overall, the wife's expectations are not unrealistic, and her husband's behavior is inconsiderate and selfish. Therefore, she is not the asshole in this situation.
